active.description: An inactive contact is kept for its history and offered for nothing new.

customer.description: A customer: invoices go to it.

customer_group_id.description: The customer group whose reminder schedule it follows (FR-AR-08); absent: the standard schedule, 3 days before the due date, on it, and 7 and 30 days after.

default_account_id.description: The category its lines start with.

default_gst_code.description: The GST code its lines start with.

discount_days.description: The days of its early-payment discount.

discount_percent.description: A supplier's early-payment discount: this percentage off its bill if paid within discount_days of the bill's date (FR-AP-13).

payment_terms_days.description: Days until its documents fall due.

peppol_id.description: Its Peppol participant ID for InvoiceNow.

possible_duplicates.description: Other contacts with the same name, UEN or tax ID, or email (FR-CT-04): review them, and merge or tell them apart.

tax_residence.description: Where it is resident for tax, ISO 3166 two-letter code, when that is not its country (FR-AP-19). A vendor resident outside Singapore (this, else its country) has its bills record the nature of the payment, and the tax agent decides whether tax is withheld.

uen_or_tax_id.description: Its UEN, or a foreign contact's tax ID.

vendor.description: A vendor: bills come from it.

version.description: The contact's version; it also makes the ETag.
